high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website moneycontrol.com. The article discusses the upcoming Cinevesture International Film Festival (CIFF) that will be held in Chandigarh from March 27 to 31, following Holi this year. The festival is described as the first international film festival in Chandigarh, celebrating diverse filmmaking across various genres, cultures, and perspectives. The text highlights several key aspects of the festival: It will feature masterclasses, workshops, and opportunities for collaboration with the film industry.
